# ovirt_tag (Data Source)

The ovirt_tag data source returns the ID and details of a tag by its name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the tag. Either id or name must be specified.
- `name` (String) Name of the tag. Either id or name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the tag.
